description:
## Why

CA/B Forum-specific profile content (`WebPkiProfile`, `SmimeProfile`, `CodeSigningProfile`, the `CABF_*_ALLOWED_ALGS` tables, SC-081 validity caps, etc.) needs a home outside `pkix-profiles` per the framework-not-policy stance (PKIX-amgn). This bead creates the empty receiving crate. The actual move of code happens in PKIX-amgn.4.

## What (scope X — empty skeleton only)

Per Mark 2026-05-11: this bead creates the empty crate. No code moves. The move is PKIX-amgn.4's job.

1. Create new workspace member `pkix-profiles-cabf/` (`Cargo.toml`, `src/lib.rs`, `README.md`).
2. `Cargo.toml`:
   - `name = "pkix-profiles-cabf"`
   - `version = "0.1.0"` (pinned in `workspace.dependencies`, following the workspace pattern).
   - `description = "Reference implementation of CA/B Forum certificate profile requirements (not authoritative)"`.
   - Publish: enabled (workspace default; no `publish = false`).
   - Deps: `der`, `pkix-path` (workspace), `pkix-profiles` (workspace, for the `Profile` trait).
3. `src/lib.rs`: empty module body, just the crate-level rustdoc header below. No re-exports yet (the move into the crate is .4).
4. Crate-level rustdoc header (prominent, top of `src/lib.rs`):

   > # pkix-profiles-cabf
   >
   > **Reference implementation of CA/B Forum cert profile requirements. Not authoritative.**
   >
   > CA/B Forum Baseline Requirements (TLS BR, S/MIME BR, Code Signing BR) change on a ballot cycle. The implementations in this crate are a snapshot of those requirements at the time of the most recent revision. They are intended as a starting point: fork and adapt to your deployment's current interpretation of the BR text, which is the only canonical source.
   >
   > For the current Baseline Requirements: see https://cabforum.org/baseline-requirements/ (TLS), https://cabforum.org/smime-br/ (S/MIME), and https://cabforum.org/code-signing-baseline-requirements/ (CS).
   >
   > Maintained on a best-effort basis. If your deployment depends on bit-exact CA/B Forum conformance, you SHOULD vendor and review the relevant rule definitions yourself.

5. `README.md` mirrors the rustdoc header.
6. Add `"pkix-profiles-cabf"` to root `Cargo.toml` `workspace.members`.
7. Add `pkix-profiles-cabf = { path = "pkix-profiles-cabf", version = "0.1.0" }` to root `Cargo.toml` `[workspace.dependencies]`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-profiles-cabf` crate skeleton exists in the workspace.
- [ ] `cargo check --workspace --all-features` clean.
- [ ] `cargo doc --workspace` clean.
- [ ] Rustdoc header carries the not-authoritative caveat verbatim, including all three CA/B Forum BR URLs (TLS, S/MIME, Code Signing).
- [ ] `README.md` mirrors the rustdoc header.
- [ ] Workspace `Cargo.toml` `members` + `workspace.dependencies` updated.

## Out of scope (handled by PKIX-amgn.4)

- Moving `WebPkiProfile`, `SmimeProfile`, `CodeSigningProfile`, `CABF_*_ALLOWED_ALGS` tables, or any other CA/B Forum content out of `pkix-profiles`.
- Adding `BasicSmimeProfile` / `BasicTlsProfile` to `pkix-profiles`.
- Deprecation shims in `pkix-profiles` for moved types.
- Maintaining the crate long-term — maintainer decision separate from creation.
- Implementing PKIX-jbvb's S/MIME BR sub-profile families (Org/Sponsor/Individual) here — that's PKIX-amgn.6 reparenting work.

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.1 (stance anchor — CLOSED).
